tree.heading: Collection.—
tree.text: The term “collection” means a collection of intellectual and cultural artifacts, including documents, sculpture, and works of art.

tree.heading: Eligible entity.—
tree.text: The term “eligible entity” means a Federal entity, State, local, or tribal government, educational institution, or nonprofit organization.

tree.heading: Historic property.—
tree.text: The term “historic property” has the meaning given the term in section 300308 of this title.

tree.heading: Nationally significant.—
tree.text: The term “nationally significant”, in reference to a collection or historic property, means a collection or historic property that meets the applicable criteria for national significance, in accordance with regulations promulgated by the Secretary pursuant to section 302103 of this title.

tree.heading: Program.—
tree.text: The term “program” means the Save America’s Treasures Program established under section 308902(a) of this title.

tree.heading: Secretary.—
tree.text: The term “Secretary” means the Secretary, acting through the Director.
